table.name: cards
table.purpose: One row per physical printing of a Magic: The Gathering card (MTGJSON AllPrintings 'cards' data). Each row describes a single printing in a specific set, including its game characteristics (mana cost, types, power/toughness, rules text), print characteristics (rarity, border, frame, promo flags), and cross-references to vendor IDs, Scryfall/MTGJSON UUIDs, and related tables (sets, rulings, legalities, foreign_data).

asciiName.name: asciiName
asciiName.description: ASCII-transliterated card name, populated only for cards whose original name contains non-ASCII characters (e.g. Arabian Nights cards like El-Hajjaj).

availability.name: availability
availability.description: Comma-separated list of platforms the card is available on: paper, mtgo, arena, shandalar.

borderColor.name: borderColor
borderColor.description: Color of the card border: black, white, gold (Un-sets), silver (Un-sets), or borderless.

cardKingdomFoilId.name: cardKingdomFoilId
cardKingdomFoilId.description: Card Kingdom product ID for the foil version of this printing, used for purchase links.

cardKingdomId.name: cardKingdomId
cardKingdomId.description: Card Kingdom product ID for the non-foil version of this printing, used for purchase links.

colorIdentity.name: colorIdentity
colorIdentity.description: Comma-separated mana color identity (W, U, B, R, G) used for deck-building rules (e.g. Commander); empty for colorless cards.

colorIndicator.name: colorIndicator
colorIndicator.description: Color indicator symbol(s) printed on the card face (small colored dot defining the card's color when it has no mana cost), e.g. on the back faces of some double-faced cards.

colors.name: colors
colors.description: Comma-separated colors derived from the card's mana cost; null for colorless cards (lands, most artifacts).

convertedManaCost.name: convertedManaCost
convertedManaCost.description: Converted mana cost (total generic mana value) of the card; the 1000000 max value is a sentinel used for cards with no mana cost that are not castable (e.g. certain tokens/emblems).

duelDeck.name: duelDeck
duelDeck.description: For cards from Duel Decks products, which deck the card belongs to: 'a' or 'b'.

edhrecRank.name: edhrecRank
edhrecRank.description: Popularity rank of the card on EDHREC (Commander format statistics); lower is more popular.

faceConvertedManaCost.name: faceConvertedManaCost
faceConvertedManaCost.description: Converted mana cost of an individual face of a multi-faced card (split/transform cards), where it differs from the whole card's CMC.

faceName.name: faceName
faceName.description: Name of the individual face for multi-faced cards (split, transform, adventure, etc.), e.g. 'Fire' of Fire // Ice.

flavorName.name: flavorName
flavorName.description: Alternate 'flavor' name used on promotional printings (e.g. the Godzilla-series Ikoria cards with names like 'Godzilla, King of the Monsters').

flavorText.name: flavorText
flavorText.description: Flavor text printed on the card (italic narrative text with no game effect).

frameEffects.name: frameEffects
frameEffects.description: Comma-separated list of special card-frame treatments: legendary, extendedart, nyxtouched, showcase, miracle, snow, etc.

frameVersion.name: frameVersion
frameVersion.description: Year of the card frame design: 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015, or 'future' (Future Sight frame).

hand.name: hand
hand.description: Vanguard-format starting hand-size modifier printed on the card (only on Vanguard cards).

hasAlternativeDeckLimit.name: hasAlternativeDeckLimit
hasAlternativeDeckLimit.description: Boolean flag: card allows an alternative deck-building limit (e.g. 'any number of' cards like Relentless Rats, Seven Dwarves).

hasContentWarning.name: hasContentWarning
hasContentWarning.description: Boolean flag: card has content considered offensive or requiring warning (e.g. racist imagery in old printings).

hasFoil.name: hasFoil
hasFoil.description: Boolean flag: this printing exists in foil version.

hasNonFoil.name: hasNonFoil
hasNonFoil.description: Boolean flag: this printing exists in non-foil version.

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key for the table (row identifier).

isAlternative.name: isAlternative
isAlternative.description: Boolean flag: printing is an alternate version (alternate art/frame within the same set, e.g. showcase variants).

isFullArt.name: isFullArt
isFullArt.description: Boolean flag: printing has full-art treatment (artwork extends over the whole card).

isOnlineOnly.name: isOnlineOnly
isOnlineOnly.description: Boolean flag: card exists only in online (MTGO/Arena) form, never printed in paper.

isOversized.name: isOversized
isOversized.description: Boolean flag: card is oversized (e.g. Commander oversized planeswalker cards).

isPromo.name: isPromo
isPromo.description: Boolean flag: printing is a promotional card.

isReprint.name: isReprint
isReprint.description: Boolean flag: card has been printed in an earlier set (not a first printing).

isReserved.name: isReserved
isReserved.description: Boolean flag: card is on the Reserved List (Wizards' promise never to reprint certain rare cards).

isStarter.name: isStarter
isStarter.description: Boolean flag: card is from a starter/intro/core-product deck rather than a booster pack (MTGJSON 'starter' flag).

isStorySpotlight.name: isStorySpotlight
isStorySpotlight.description: Boolean flag: card is a story spotlight printing (marked as tied to the set's narrative).

isTextless.name: isTextless
isTextless.description: Boolean flag: card has no text box (textless promo printings).

isTimeshifted.name: isTimeshifted
isTimeshifted.description: Boolean flag: card is a timeshifted printing (purple Time Spiral 'timeshifted' frame or similar).

keywords.name: keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated list of keyword abilities on the card (Flying, Trample, Cycling, etc.).

layout.name: layout
layout.description: Card layout type: normal, split, transform, modal_dfc, adventure, leveler, augment, scheme, etc.

leadershipSkills.name: leadershipSkills
leadershipSkills.description: Serialized dict of booleans indicating whether the card can be a commander in brawl, commander, and oathbreaker formats.

life.name: life
life.description: Vanguard-format starting life modifier printed on the card (only on Vanguard cards).

loyalty.name: loyalty
loyalty.description: Starting loyalty of a planeswalker card; may be non-numeric strings like '1d4+1' or '*' for special cases.

manaCost.name: manaCost
manaCost.description: Mana cost in MTG symbol notation, e.g. '{1}{W}' or '{R/G}{R/G}'; null for lands and costless cards.

mcmId.name: mcmId
mcmId.description: Cardmarket product ID for this specific printing (used for price/purchase links).

mcmMetaId.name: mcmMetaId
mcmMetaId.description: Cardmarket meta/product-group ID, shared across printings of the same card.

mtgArenaId.name: mtgArenaId
mtgArenaId.description: MTG Arena internal card ID, present only for cards available on Arena.

mtgjsonV4Id.name: mtgjsonV4Id
mtgjsonV4Id.description: MTGJSON v4 UUID identifying this printing.

mtgoFoilId.name: mtgoFoilId
mtgoFoilId.description: MTGO catalog ID for the foil version of this printing on Magic Online.

mtgoId.name: mtgoId
mtgoId.description: MTGO catalog ID for the non-foil version of this printing on Magic Online.

multiverseId.name: multiverseId
multiverseId.description: Gatherer/Wizards of the Coast multiverse ID for this printing; null for cards not in Gatherer.

name.name: name
name.description: Card name (English); duplicates exist because the same card is printed in many sets.

number.name: number
number.description: Collector number within the set, sometimes with letter prefixes/suffixes (e.g. 'br79', '22c', 'jf324').

originalReleaseDate.name: originalReleaseDate
originalReleaseDate.description: Original release date (YYYY/MM/DD) for promotional printings released outside a set; null for regular set cards.

originalText.name: originalText
originalText.description: Rules text as originally printed (using the wording of the card's first printing); for basic lands holds the mana color letter.

originalType.name: originalType
originalType.description: Card type line as originally printed (old wordings like 'Summon - Fungus').

otherFaceIds.name: otherFaceIds
otherFaceIds.description: List of mtgjsonV4Id UUIDs of the other faces of a multi-faced card (split/transform/etc.).

power.name: power
power.description: Power of a creature card; may be non-numeric ('*', '2+*') for variable power.

printings.name: printings
printings.description: Comma-separated list of set codes in which this card has been printed (all printings of the card, not just this row's set).

promoTypes.name: promoTypes
promoTypes.description: Comma-separated list of promo categories for promotional printings: prerelease, datestamped, mediainsert, boxtopper, convention, etc.

purchaseUrls.name: purchaseUrls
purchaseUrls.description: Serialized dict of vendor purchase links (cardKingdom, cardKingdomFoil, cardmarket, tcgplayer) via mtgjson.com redirect URLs.

rarity.name: rarity
rarity.description: Rarity of this printing: common, uncommon, rare, or mythic.

scryfallId.name: scryfallId
scryfallId.description: Scryfall card ID (UUID) for this printing; a few duplicates exist for alternate printings sharing artwork IDs.

scryfallIllustrationId.name: scryfallIllustrationId
scryfallIllustrationId.description: Scryfall illustration ID, shared by all printings using the same artwork.

scryfallOracleId.name: scryfallOracleId
scryfallOracleId.description: Scryfall oracle ID, shared by all printings of the same card (same rules text), matching the name duplication counts.

setCode.name: setCode
setCode.description: Code of the set this printing belongs to (e.g. 2XM, LEA, PRM); references sets.code.

side.name: side
side.description: For multi-faced cards, which face this row represents: a, b, c, d, or e.

supertypes.name: supertypes
supertypes.description: Comma-separated supertypes: Basic, Legendary, Snow, World, Ongoing.

tcgplayerProductId.name: tcgplayerProductId
tcgplayerProductId.description: TCGplayer product ID for this printing, used for price/purchase links.

text.name: text
text.description: Current (Oracle) rules text of the card; basic lands hold their mana ability like '({T}: Add {G}.)'.

toughness.name: toughness
toughness.description: Toughness of a creature card; may be non-numeric ('*', '*+1') for variable toughness.

type.name: type
type.description: Full current type line, e.g. 'Creature — Kor Artificer' or 'Basic Land — Plains'.

types.name: types
types.description: Comma-separated card types (Creature, Instant, Sorcery, Land, Artifact, Enchantment, Summon for very old cards).

uuid.name: uuid
uuid.description: MTGJSON v5 UUID uniquely identifying this printing; referenced by rulings, foreign_data, and legalities tables.

variations.name: variations
variations.description: Comma-separated list of UUIDs of other printings/variations of the same card (same name, different set or treatment).

watermark.name: watermark
watermark.description: Watermark printed on the card: faction names (mirran, phyrexian, golgari, dimir, izzet) or 'set (CODE)' for set-symbol watermarks.

table.name: foreign_data
table.purpose: Localized (foreign-language) printings of Magic: The Gathering cards: for each card (uuid referencing cards) and language, the translated name, rules text, type line, flavor text, and Gatherer multiverse ID. One row per card-language printing; cards without translations in a language have no row, and empty strings mark missing flavor/text/type. The 'id' column is a surrogate primary key; its statistical joins to cards price-site IDs are spurious numeric coincidences, not real relationships.

flavorText.name: flavorText
flavorText.description: Flavor text of the card in the given language; empty string when the card has no flavor text.

id.name: id
id.description: Synthetic primary key for this table (row identifier). The detected joins to cards.tcgplayerProductId / cardKingdomId etc. are coincidental numeric overlaps, not real relationships.

language.name: language
language.description: Language of this foreign printing, e.g. Japanese, French, German, Spanish, plus rare ones (Ancient Greek, Sanskrit, Latin, Hebrew).

multiverseid.name: multiverseid
multiverseid.description: Gatherer multiverse ID of the foreign printing; null for printings without a Gatherer page.

name.name: name
name.description: Localized (translated) card name in the given language.

text.name: text
text.description: Localized rules text of the card; empty for cards with no rules text.

type.name: type
type.description: Localized card type line (e.g. 'Kreatur — Zyklop', 'Criatura Lendária — Guerreiro Goblin'); empty when no type line.

uuid.name: uuid
uuid.description: Foreign key to cards.uuid — identifies the (English) card this is a translation of; one card has many language rows.

table.name: legalities
table.purpose: Per-card Magic: The Gathering format legality: for each card (uuid, referencing cards.uuid) and each tournament format, records whether the card is Legal, Banned, or Restricted in that format. One row per card-format pair (up to 15 formats per card, ~55.6k distinct cards).

format.name: format
format.description: Magic: The Gathering tournament format in which the card's legality is stated (e.g. commander, legacy, vintage, modern, pioneer, pauper, duel, penny, premodern). 15 distinct formats.

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key for the legality row; sequential integer 1..427907 with no semantic meaning. The 'joins' to cards.mcmId etc. are spurious statistical coincidences, not real relationships.

status.name: status
status.description: Legality of the card in the given format: Legal, Banned, or Restricted (Restricted applies to formats like Vintage).

uuid.name: uuid
uuid.description: Foreign key to cards.uuid — identifies the card (printing) whose legality is being stated. Each card has up to 15 rows, one per format.

table.name: rulings
table.purpose: Official Magic: The Gathering rulings (oracle/rules clarifications) per card printing, from MTGJSON's rulings data. Each row is one ruling attached to a card (cards.uuid), with its publication date and ruling text. The 2004-10-04 bulk date corresponds to the classic comprehensive-rules overhaul; later spikes correspond to set releases.

date.name: date
date.description: Date the ruling was issued/published (ISO date, 2004-10-04 to 2021-02-05). Many rulings share dates because they were released in bulk updates.

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key, sequential integer 1–87769, one per ruling row.

text.name: text
text.description: Full text of the rules/oracle ruling explaining how the card works. Duplicated text (uniqueness 0.223) occurs because the same ruling text is attached to multiple printings/cards sharing an ability.

uuid.name: card_uuid
uuid.description: Foreign key to cards.uuid — the card (printing) the ruling applies to. Many rulings per card (many_to_one).

table.name: set_translations
table.purpose: Localized names of Magic: The Gathering expansion sets: one row per (set, language) pair, giving the set's name translated into that language. 121 sets × 10 languages = 1210 rows. Joins to sets via setCode → sets.code.

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key; sequential integer 1–1210, one per row.

language.name: language
language.description: Full name of the language the set name is translated into (e.g. Chinese Simplified, French, Japanese, Korean, Russian). 10 languages, each appearing 121 times — one translation per language per set.

setCode.name: setCode
setCode.description: Code of the Magic: The Gathering set whose name is being translated (e.g. 10E = Tenth Edition, RTR = Return to Ravnica, TSP = Time Spiral). References sets.code (many-to-one).

translation.name: translation
translation.description: The set's name translated into the given language (e.g. 'Ritorno a Ravnica' = Return to Ravnica in Italian, 'イーブンタイド' = Eventide in Japanese). Null (~19%) where no translation exists for that language/set pair; English-language values appear where the set name is not translated.

table.name: sets
table.purpose: One row per Magic: The Gathering card set/expansion/product release (551 sets, 1993–2021), holding its code, name, release date, set type, block, size, booster composition, and flags plus external marketplace identifiers (Cardmarket, TCGplayer, MTGO). Referenced by cards and set_translations via the set code.

baseSetSize.name: base_set_size
baseSetSize.description: Number of cards in the set's base (non-promo, non-extra) printing; the count of distinct cards printed in the set excluding variants. Ranges 0–1694, small values for tiny promo sets.

block.name: block
block.description: Name of the Magic: The Gathering block (e.g. 'Theros', 'Scars of Mirrodin') or product family ('Core Set', 'Commander', 'Judge Gift Cards') the set belongs to; null for sets outside a block.

booster.name: booster_contents
booster.description: JSON (stored as text) describing the booster pack contents for the set: per-booster slot composition (commons, uncommons, rare/mythic, lands, special slots) and booster variants ('default', 'arena'). Null for sets not sold in boosters.

code.name: set_code
code.description: Unique short set code (e.g. 'TSP' = Time Spiral, 'PGRN' = Guilds of Ravnica promos) identifying the MTG set; referenced by cards.setCode and set_translations.setCode.

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key, sequential 1–551, one row per set.

isFoilOnly.name: is_foil_only
isFoilOnly.description: Boolean flag: 1 if all cards in the set exist only in foil (e.g. many promo sets), else 0.

isForeignOnly.name: is_foreign_only
isForeignOnly.description: Boolean flag: 1 if the set was released only in non-English languages.

isNonFoilOnly.name: is_non_foil_only
isNonFoilOnly.description: Boolean flag: 1 if all cards in the set exist only in non-foil.

isOnlineOnly.name: is_online_only
isOnlineOnly.description: Boolean flag: 1 if the set exists only on Magic Online / digital platforms.

isPartialPreview.name: is_partial_preview
isPartialPreview.description: Boolean flag: 1 if the set is only a partial preview of an upcoming set (only one row is flagged).

keyruneCode.name: keyrune_code
keyruneCode.description: Code for the set's icon in the Keyrune icon font (set symbol); 'DEFAULT'/'PMEI'/'DCI' are generic symbols shared by many promo sets, otherwise usually equals the set code.

mcmId.name: cardmarket_expansion_id
mcmId.description: Cardmarket (MCM, Magic Card Market) expansion ID for the set; null where the set isn't listed on Cardmarket.

mcmIdExtras.name: cardmarket_extras_expansion_id
mcmIdExtras.description: Secondary Cardmarket expansion ID used for extra/variant products of the set (e.g. separate listings for special editions); populated for only ~10 sets.

mcmName.name: cardmarket_set_name
mcmName.description: Set name as listed on Cardmarket (e.g. 'Aether Revolt', 'Zendikar Expeditions'); null where mcmId is null.

mtgoCode.name: mtgo_code
mtgoCode.description: Set code as used on Magic Online, which sometimes differs from the main code (e.g. 'PR', 'V10'); null for sets not on MTGO.

name.name: set_name
name.description: Full human-readable name of the Magic: The Gathering set (e.g. 'Ultimate Masters', 'Magic 2010', 'Mirrodin Promos'); unique per row.

parentCode.name: parent_set_code
parentCode.description: Set code of the parent set this set belongs to (e.g. promo sets pointing to their expansion, 'ZNR' for Zendikar Rising-related sets); null for standalone sets.

releaseDate.name: release_date
releaseDate.description: Release date of the set (ISO date string, 1993-08-05 to 2021-03-19); placeholder dates like YYYY-01-01 appear for sets with unknown exact dates.

tcgplayerGroupId.name: tcgplayer_group_id
tcgplayerGroupId.description: TCGplayer product group ID for the set (used to look up prices); null where the set isn't sold on TCGplayer. Value 62 repeats for 21 rows, likely a generic/promo group.

totalSetSize.name: total_set_size
totalSetSize.description: Total number of distinct cards in the set including variants/extras; always >= baseSetSize.
